ios.desc:
Clean up iPhone storage with CleanMy®Phone — an AI-powered cleaner app crafted by MacPaw. Gently clear years of photos and videos to make room for new memories.

Finding the exact photo you’re looking for amidst gigabytes of random shots, useless videos, similar images, and duplicates may seem impossible. CleanMy®Phone trims unnecessary clutter so you can easily access all your memorable moments.

Why people use CleanMy®Phone
Many iPhone users face common storage and photo-management problems, and CleanMy®Phone helps solve them quickly and safely:

 • iPhone storage is almost full
 • Too many duplicate or similar photos
 • Large videos take too much space
 • Thousands of screenshots and random images
 • Need to organize photos automatically with AI
 • Want a fast, safe way to clean up their iPhone

What can CleanMy®Phone cleaner do?

 • CLEAN UP YOUR IPHONE STORAGE
CleanMy®Phone scans your entire library for blurred photos, old screenshots, large videos, and duplicates — and helps you quickly free up space.

 • DELETE DUPLICATES AND SIMILAR PHOTOS
The app finds duplicate and similar shots, helping you choose the best photo and delete the rest.

 • MERGE SIMILAR CONTACTS
CleanMy®Phone detects duplicate and similar contacts — those with repeated names, numbers, or partial matches — and helps you merge them into a clean, organized address book with one tap.

 • COMPRESS VIDEOS
Compress videos with minimal quality loss to instantly reclaim storage.

 • TURN LIVE PHOTOS TO STILL IMAGES
Convert Live Photos into still images to save space in just one tap.

 • LET AI ORGANIZE YOUR MESSY LIBRARY
AI groups your photos into helpful categories — Travel, People, Pets, Food, Documents, Screenshots, Texts, and more — making your library easier to browse and manage.

•  TREAT YOUR PHOTOS WITH CARE
CleanMy®Phone lets you decide which photos and videos the app removes. If you accidentally delete something, you can always recover it from the Recently Deleted folder on your iPhone.

Beyond smart cleanup tools, CleanMy®Phone also focuses on privacy, control, and a smooth experience for every user.
What makes CleanMy®Phone different?

Your privacy stays on your device
 • CleanMy®Phone works fully on-device
 • You can mark photos as Sensitive so they're never included in cleanups
•  CleanMy®Phone doesn't save or upload your pictures anywhere — you're the only one who can access and see your gallery.
